terminality.reason: The Site Data Snapshot Sync-now control is real and tenant-owned, reuses the existing queued WordPress synchronization path, prevents duplicate unsafe submissions through tenant-scoped idempotency and active-run convergence, treats failed/cancelled runs as failure, and shows success only after a succeeded SyncRun followed by authoritative server reread.
